build_gtn_package: build the gtn python package with cmake extensions for graph transducer networks
build_cmake_extension: build a cmake extension module for gtn with automatic differentiation support
load_readme_description: load the README.md file to use as the long description for the gtn package
configure_gtn_ext_modules: configure the seven gtn cmake extension modules including graph autograd and utils
run_cmake_build: run the cmake build process for gtn python bindings with release or debug config
